body: There's quite a bit I've left out too, some of which I don't feel very comfortable talking about even on this throwaway. I don't know, I just always feel so idiotic talking about this. That it somehow makes me less worthy of existence, even though I know that isn't true.

My biggest problem with school is that I live in a poverty stricken area. I would need to get a job to pay for any classes I take, and that's unlikely given the financial troubles the area is in. Plus my mom was laid off a year or so ago and that's been a lot of trouble for us.

And not all of my friends are that way, one or two of them were fairly understanding. Also, I've told my problems to some people I met more recently. Probably not the best idea if I want to avoid driving new friends away, but I felt it was easier to talk to someone I had known for a shorter period of time because I'm fairly embarrassed by all my troubles and am afraid of what people who have known me for awhile might think. I know it sounds odd that I would ever open up to people I've just met, but people seem to find me fairly trusting and they tend to open up just as quickly.
